method.price: Stated willingness to pay at or above your price, never a sales forecast. Price bands are ranges, so the share is a range: it clears only if even the conservative count clears the bar.
method.liking: Share answering Love it or Like it, asked before any battle. Against your current pack it is the paired difference on the same respondents.
method.confidence: 95%, fixed by Dough; brands set the bars, never the confidence.
method.result_rule: Cleared when the whole interval sits at or above the bar, not cleared when it sits below, too close to call when it straddles; fewer than 10 answers reads as not enough responses.
method.head_to_head: Each respondent's single direct battle between the design and the benchmark (scoring rounds, timing-flagged battles excluded); Wilson interval. Neither answers are shown and not counted as wins.
